s2:Discovering gravitational waves with Advanced LIGO, 2020-10-01

rationale: The paper 2001.05909 investigates mechanisms for enhancing small-scale overdensity perturbations during inflation to produce primordial black holes, directly addressing the question by proposing a new mechanism based on G and k inflations. This contributes substantive new evidence on part of the question.
